nodes.label: DualityCert: Verifier-Gated Language-Model Repair of Broken Duality Claims in QFT
nodes.author: Xingyang Yu
nodes.rationale: Presents a symbolic verifier for Seiberg-duality claims in quantum field theory, using language-model agents to repair broken claims through iterative refinement gated by consistency checks.

nodes.label: DualityCert Verifier
nodes.rationale: Symbolic verifier evaluating consistency obligations for Seiberg-duality claims including 't Hooft anomaly matching, superpotential R-charge consistency, central-charge matching, and bounded chiral-ring consistency.

nodes.label: DualityCert Repair Environment
nodes.rationale: Interactive environment where language-model agents receive broken duality claims and iteratively edit them until they pass verifier certification.

nodes.label: Seiberg Duality
nodes.rationale: Statement that two different four-dimensional N=1 gauge theories flow to the same infrared physics; central to the paper's domain.

nodes.label: DualityCert Benchmark (145 repairable claims)
nodes.rationale: Preregistered benchmark of 145 broken duality claims generated from six seed families of quiver gauge theories, perturbed at depth one.

nodes.label: DualityCert Repair Policies (ss, gr, vf, vf_masked, best_of_n)
nodes.rationale: Five policies controlling feedback projection and agent interaction: single-shot, generic retry, verifier feedback, masked feedback, and independent verifier-filtered resampling.
